journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society 49(8), 1974-1988
title: The Vapor Pressure of the Saturated Aqueous Solutions of Certain Salts
experimental_method: Static direct manometric measurement of the vapour pressure of saturated salt solutions (air removed by repeated pumping) with a mercury manometer and a depth gauge, at 20 to 50 C, 24 h or more at each temperature.
uncertainties_stated: Uncertainty in final results stated as not greater than 0.05 mm (Hg); readings uncertain by about 0.03-0.04 mm; temperature constant to +-0.01 C.
quality_remarks: Molality of the saturated solutions is read from a smoothed solubility curve of literature data, not measured. Vapour pressure of water p0 is from the Reichsanstalt tables. Temperature scale not stated. Table I (Concluded) NaCl+KCl block has no molality. Some molality/Delta sequences look irregular (e.g. Na2SO4 3.473 at two temperatures; K2SO4 24.73 C Delta .04857) as printed.
how_extracted: pdf_text_layer, then every cell compared with the 200 dpi page images
